clue.text: Help for a hard working chef?

definitions.text: Help for a hard working chef?

parts.words: Help for a hard working chef?
parts.note: read as a cook toiling hard, but the hard work is done by a sealed pan that builds up steam to cook tough food quickly

explanation.surface: A request for an assistant for an overworked cook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hard working' suggests a busy chef; read it instead as the appliance doing the hard work, cooking quickly under sealed steam.
explanation.definitionFit: A sealed pan that cooks food fast by steam at high pressure is a kitchen aid for any cook.

clue.text: Registered house doctor in shape

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for registered, as on a trademark
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A registered house doctor is somehow found within a geometric figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhombus, a four-sided figure with equal sides, is a geometric figure.

clue.text: Promises the ship will carry clothes

indicators.note: a vessel that will carry cargo holds it within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: SS, steamship, is the usual prefix for a ship
wear is clothing, as in menswear

explanation.surface: A vessel's crew are assured their garments will travel with them.
explanation.definitionFit: To swear is to promise solemnly, as in an oath.

clue.text: A Latin rule that's broken on one side

indicators.note: a rule that is broken is smashed up here, so its letters with those before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rule in Latin grammar is flouted by only one party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That's broken' rearranges the ten letters of A LATIN RULE.
explanation.definitionFit: Unilateral action is taken by one party alone, affecting a single side.

clue.text: Mr Roosevelt lost his head in a whirl

indicators.note: losing the head means dropping the first letter of the name

parts.note: Teddy was the nickname of US President Theodore Roosevelt

explanation.surface: An American president is beheaded amid the confusion of events.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lost his head' removes T from TEDDY.
explanation.definitionFit: An eddy is a swirling current of water or air, a small whirlpool.

clue.text: Sketch revealed wrinkle

parts.note: out means made public, as when a secret is out
a line is a crease on the face

explanation.surface: A drawing shows up a crease in someone's face.
explanation.definitionFit: An outline is a rough draft or summary drawing showing only the main features.

clue.text: Two chess pieces combine to capture rook and make a meal of it

parts.note: the king is a chess piece

indicators.note: capturing something takes it inside, so one letter goes within a piece

parts.note: the pawn is a second chess piece
R is the chess notation for rook

explanation.surface: In chess, two pieces team up to take a rook and make a feast of the game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To capture' signals the container; 'combine' just joins the two chess pieces. 'Make a meal of it' sounds like overdoing things, but the meal is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: A large prawn served as a dish is something one eats as food.

clue.text: Greens hatching plot to create new order

indicators.note: a plot is a scheme, so the letters are schemed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Environmental campaigners are scheming to bring about political change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plot' rearranges all fourteen letters of GREENS HATCHING; 'Greens' wants to be political ecologists.
explanation.definitionFit: Ringing the changes means varying the arrangement, from bell-ringers' sequences of peals.

clue.text: Seaside attractions of waves swallowing a ship

indicators.note: something swallowing takes it in, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: rollers are long heavy waves
a coaster is a ship that sails along a coast

explanation.surface: Breakers at sea engulf a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swallowing' signals the container; the ship goes in before the plural S of the waves. 'Seaside' looks like a link to 'waves' but belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Fairground rides on steep tracks are a fixture of resort piers and funfairs.

clue.text: Agreed to give men food in mess

indicators.note: a mess is a muddle, so these letters are jumbled; it is also where troops eat

explanation.surface: Soldiers consent to be fed in the canteen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mess' rearranges MEN FOOD IN; it pretends to be a military dining room.
explanation.definitionFit: People who share an opinion are in full accord, thinking alike.

clue.text: Not one comes back on time to make the joint

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece placed on another follows it
coming back means the word for not one is read backwards

parts.note: none means not one

explanation.surface: Nobody returns punctually to make the carpentry connection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Comes back' signals the reversal, and 'on' in an across clue means the turned word follows the time letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenon is the projecting tongue of wood that fits a mortise in carpentry.

clue.text: Country, part of Europe that's on the left

indicators.note: the letter for left sits on the left side, at the front of the region

parts.note: Iberia is the peninsula of Spain and Portugal

explanation.surface: A nation described as a European region on the political left.
explanation.definitionFit: Liberia is a West African nation founded by freed American slaves.

clue.text: Sticker or permit admitting one member

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so pieces go inside another

parts.note: to let is to allow
I is the Roman numeral one
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A label or licence lets in one more person.
explanation.definitionFit: A limpet is a shellfish that clings tightly to rocks, so it sticks fast.

clue.text: I appear in green wing, drunk on it!

definitions.text: I appear in green wing, drunk on it!

indicators.note: being drunk means muddled, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone tipsy finds themselves in a hospital ward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drunk' rearranges I, GREEN and WING; the whole clue doubles as a picture of the tipsy drinker.
explanation.definitionFit: Ginger wine is a fortified drink flavoured with the spice, so it can leave one tipsy.

clue.text: Low resistance reversing into space

indicators.note: reversing means the whole run of words low and resistance is read backwards

parts.note: to low is to moo, like a cow
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: Weak opposition backs into an empty area.
explanation.definitionFit: Room is available space, as in room to move.

clue.text: No more odds on poor being excess to housing stock

parts.note: over means finished, no more
SP, starting price, is the betting odds on a horse
ill means poor or bad, as in ill health

explanation.surface: Betting on the needy surplus in housing.
explanation.definitionFit: Overspill is the surplus population rehoused from a crowded city to a new town.

clue.text: Consider case of deportee set free

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outside, its first and last letters

parts.note: to liberate is to release

explanation.surface: Weigh up whether a deported person should be released.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliberate is to think carefully about something.

clue.text: The bowling rate will incur too heavy a cost

parts.note: an over is a set of six balls bowled in cricket
a charge is a price or rate

explanation.surface: The fee for a cricket bowler's spell will be excessive.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, an over is a set of six deliveries by one bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: An overcharge is an excessive price demanded.

clue.text: Elegant, middle class function in the city

parts.note: chic means stylish

indicators.note: middle points to the central letter of the word class

parts.note: to go is to work, as a machine goes

explanation.surface: A stylish bourgeois party is held in town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Middle class' sounds like the bourgeoisie, but it gives A, the centre of CLASS.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicago is a major city of Illinois in the US.

clue.text: A measure of the ruler's slow progress?

definitions.text: A measure of the ruler's slow progress?

parts.words: A measure of the ruler's slow progress?
parts.note: a ruler measures in small units of length, and the same word for that unit also means to move forward slowly

explanation.surface: How far a monarch has crept forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ruler' tempts as a monarch; it is the measuring stick, marked with small units, and the unit's name also means to creep.
explanation.definitionFit: An inch is a unit of length and also a verb meaning to move very slowly.

clue.text: Performing at said arenas

indicators.note: performing suggests acting out, so these letters are put through a new routine

explanation.surface: Shows put on at venues that were mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: Stadia is the Latin-style plural of stadium, a large sports ground.

clue.text: Albatross is kingfisher — or some other bird?

indicators.note: some of the letters of the words albatross is kingfisher are taken, spanning the words

explanation.surface: A puzzled birder wonders which species is which.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes letters spanning albatrosS IS KINgfisher.
explanation.definitionFit: A siskin is a small yellowish finch.

clue.text: Teach new skills to soldiers' column

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are soldiers of the British Army
a train is a long line, as a column of vehicles

explanation.surface: An army instructor drills a line of troops.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrain is to teach someone again for a different job.

clue.text: Divorced due to a film role

parts.note: a part is an actor's role

explanation.surface: An actor's marriage ended because of a movie role.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple living apart are separated, as after a split.

clue.text: Second incision made in tail

parts.note: a cut is an incision

explanation.surface: A surgeon makes another cut in an animal's rear.
explanation.definitionFit: A scut is the short tail of a rabbit, hare or deer.

clue.text: The girl who likes a rice dish?

indicators.note: to dish something is to spoil it, so these letters are messed up

explanation.surface: A young woman with a taste for risotto.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dish' rearranges A RICE; it pretends to be a plate of food.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is a female first name, so a girl could be called that.

clue.text: Minor caution means local authority supervision

parts.note: a minor is a child under legal age
care means caution, as in take care

explanation.surface: A warning to a youngster means social services step in.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a child in care is under council supervision.
explanation.definitionFit: Children taken into council care are looked after by social services.

clue.text: A marvellous chap is the sailor grounded

parts.note: an old salt is an experienced sailor
something grounded is on land, belonging to the soil

explanation.surface: A great fellow is a seaman stuck ashore.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase from the Gospels describes a decent, honest, dependable person.
